W-01.note: register outlier: 'coeval' is the rarest/most technical word in the set; other three are common

W-03.note: two near-synonym pairs (halted/deferred, floating/hanging) cancel; picked the more formal of the resolvable pair

W-04.note: hedging: 'provisional' is the qualified option, the other three are absolute or off-axis

W-05.note: hedging: 'modest' is the degree-qualifier; uniform/seasonal describe pattern not size

W-06.note: collocation: only 'perceptible' takes a barely/scarcely frame with 'difference'

W-07.note: hedge: 'parallels' is the weakest claim; refines/displaces/inherits all assert a causal or genealogical relation

W-08.note: split 2-2 physical (dissolves/separates) vs epistemic (settles/determines); within the epistemic pair 'determines' is absolute so 'settles' is the survivor

W-09.note: three options mark low authority (provisional/unofficial/retrospective), one high; could not decide direction

W-10.note: collocation: 'anecdotal evidence' is the fixed phrase; the other three do not modify evidence idiomatically

W-11.note: rare-sense: headword is 'economy'; distractors are the common (trade/finance), etymological (household) and price senses, key is the secondary 'thrift' sense

W-13.note: collocation: only 'adjudicate' takes a dispute/case as object in this register

W-14.note: near-synonym pair curbed/halted, hedging picks the partial one; verified/recorded are the other cancelling pair

W-15.note: odd one out: chronicle/publicize/instruct are communicative acts, 'discern' is perception

W-16.note: near-synonym elimination: framework/structure are interchangeable so neither can be a unique key; 'composition' beats 'appearance' as the makeup sense

W-17.note: sense-partition on 'temperate': climate/verdict/enthusiasm glosses are the literal or punning senses, key is the moderate-and-restrained sense (matches W-50)

W-19.note: odd one out: three glosses all reference home, 'plain and unadorned' is the only one that does not - the tested secondary sense of 'homely'

W-20.note: odd one out: literal/exacting/faithful cluster as strict fidelity, 'idiomatic' is the lone contrast

W-21.note: hedge: 'modifies' is the qualified verb; justifies/disputes/certifies are all strong stances

W-22.note: economy family (see W-11/30/32): money-sense set, key is 'frugality'

W-23.note: curated/edited are near-synonyms and cancel; 'staged' is the only option asserting artifice, which is what such a stem is for

W-24.note: odd one out: colonize/domesticate/cultivate are all human action on nature, 'accommodate' reverses the direction

W-25.note: rare-sense: headword 'address'; residence, speech and letter-directing are the three common senses, key is the rare 'adroitness' sense

W-26.note: three options are evidence-evaluative and 'dispositive' is the one that collocates with evidence in a 'far from ___' frame

W-28.note: odd one out: schooled/restrained/directed are all exercise of authority, 'trailed' is the only physical-following verb

W-29.note: odd one out: discipline/bargaining/sabotage are labor-relations acts, 'insurance' is the figurative functional reading such stems reward

W-30.note: economy family: this set is the style/means sense (spareness) not the money sense; frugality is the cross-item decoy carried over from W-22

W-31.note: figurative-over-literal: pigment and blushing are the literal senses of 'color', 'bias the impression of' is the tested figurative one

W-32.note: economy family: money-sense set, 'thrift' is the sparing-use gloss; commerce/system are the common-sense decoys

W-33.note: specificity: incomplete/premature/unwarranted are degree words, 'circular' names a structural defect - the precise option

W-34.note: literal-trap: 'Financial gains' is the surface money reading, key is the non-literal gradual-accumulation gloss

W-35.note: hedge/mid-strength: provoke and toughen are strong, harmonize off-axis, 'moderate' is the qualified verb

W-37.note: collocation: 'anticipated later developments' is the idiom these stems use; resisted/invited/recorded do not take that object

W-38.note: odd one out: locate/separate/enlarge are physical operations, 'settle' is the lone epistemic verb

W-40.note: odd one out: concession/oversight/maneuver are all strategic or error readings, 'a genuine prediction' is the only epistemic one and the only one with an intensifier

W-41.note: near-synonym elimination: candor and contrition are both sincerity readings and cancel; between prestige and lapse the strategic reading is the one a stem rewards

W-43.note: collocation: a measurement stem ('too coarse to ___') takes 'detect'; enroll is the odd one out

W-45.note: sense-partition on 'critical' (decisive/essential/censorious/analytic) but with no sibling item to say which sense is aimed at

W-46.note: negotiation/accommodation are near-synonyms so by my own rule neither should be key; picked anyway

W-49.note: odd one out: defer/arrest/offset all counteract an effect, 'obscure' is the lone epistemic verb

W-50.note: sense-partition on 'temperate', same as W-17: climate and teetotal glosses are the literal senses, key is 'measured'
